name: moodle-test-submit
description: Run your unit tests and submit the results to Moodle

moodleSubmit.serviceUrl.description: Base URL of the Java submission service (e.g. https://moodle-bridge.example.edu).

moodleSubmit.requestTimeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds for requests to the submission service.

moodleSubmit.assignmentKey.description: Fallback assignment key, used when the workspace has no .moodle-submit.json file.

moodleSubmit.authScopes.description: OAuth scopes to request from the Microsoft authentication provider. The default targets the standard submission service's Entra ID App Registration — only change this if you're pointing at a different deployment.

moodleSubmit.testCommandOverrides.description: Per-adapter command overrides, e.g. { "maven-junit": "mvn -Pci test" }, for projects with nonstandard build setups. Give a single command with no shell operators (&&, |, ;): the reporting flags that let the extension read the results are appended to whatever you put here.

moodleSubmit.preferredAdapter.description: Force a specific test adapter instead of relying on auto-detection.
